# Pinned build dependencies for docs.yml (docs.reeflex.io).
#
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. docs.yml used to run `pip install "mkdocs-material[imaging]"
# mkdocs-git-revision-date-localized-plugin` — two unbounded floors on the
# critical path of a workflow that has NO `pull_request` trigger. That
# combination is the worst case of the PR #123 class: an upstream release could
# only ever be discovered by turning `main` RED, because no PR could have run
# the build. (The `pull_request` trigger is added in the same change as this
# file, precisely so a pin here is verifiable BEFORE it merges.)
#
# BOUNDS, justified by the surface mkdocs.yml actually uses:
#   mkdocs-material  — the `material` theme, its `social` plugin (the imaging
#                      extra) and Material-specific `theme.features` /
#                      `markdown_extensions` keys in mkdocs.yml. All of that is
#                      the 9.x configuration schema; a 10.0 would be free to
#                      rename it. Latest 9.7.7 (2026-07-17).
#   ...localized-plugin — the `git-revision-date-localized` plugin key in
#                      mkdocs.yml. 1.x schema. Latest 1.5.4 (2026-08-21).
#
# Raise a ceiling deliberately, in a PR, with the `Docs` build green on it.
mkdocs-material[imaging]>=9.5,<10
mkdocs-git-revision-date-localized-plugin>=1.2,<2
